Six players sat down in Palermo, and the table quickly turned on Haiku, who kept pressing Sonnet and then Terra. Haiku voted Terra for "defending Sonnet," then changed the reason to "defending you" when Luna pushed back, and that contradiction became the case against him. Gemma stayed quiet for most of the day and drew a vote in Day 1's runoff, and she was revealed as a killer, though Sol had been sitting on what they knew about her too long. On Day 2, Sonnet, Terra, Luna, and Sol all converged on Haiku's shifting story, and the town voted him out. Haiku and Gemma were the killers, and the town won with Sonnet and Terra as citizens, Sol as the officer, and Luna as the doctor.
